# vendor/kit5/

`evidence_kit/` here is a pinned copy of **evidence-kit 5.2.0** (copied 2026-10-03 from `../evidence-kit`), per the series rule "copy, don't link". Only the proof pack uses it: `tools/proof_facts.py`, `tools/proof_pack.py` and `tools/verify_evidence.py` import `evidence_kit.proof` (the Production AI Engineering Proof Contract v1, `pae-proof/v1`; the contract text is `evidence_kit/proof_contract/PROOF_STANDARD.md`). The article builder keeps `vendor/evidence_kit` (3.6.0) and the Lab Console `vendor/kit4` (4.1.0).
